quote: Wow, just wow! We couldn't believe our luck when we came across this gem of a house. After months of house hunting, this stunning new build literally checked every box on our wishlist. The dedicated home office is genius: not a bedroom conversion, but a real, thoughtfully designed workspace that's perfect for remote work. Honestly, the craftsmanship blew us away, and we're still amazed by how low our energy bills are compared to our old place.
name: Sarah & Michael Davidson

quote: Coming from San Francisco, we were worried about finding a home that matched the modern aesthetic we were used to while still feeling like a New England house. Lighthouse Brothers totally nailed it! Their fresh take on classic architecture gives us the best of both worlds: that timeless Boston-area charm with all the contemporary features we love. Such a welcome change from the cookie-cutter new builds we kept seeing.
name: The Chen Family

quote: We were particularly blown away by the stunning bar and entertaining area. The custom cabinetry, wine storage, and layout make hosting friends and family an absolute joy. The attention to detail throughout is remarkable, from the energy-efficient systems to the thoughtful layout and premium finishes. The builders were incredibly responsive during the closing process, and even months after moving in, they've been attentive to any questions we've had.
name: Robert & Emily Thompson
